notes: Important read: the solid green horizontal line - the 'green line' Ace repeatedly trades off - sits at 69,011.1, not at 69,361.4. Verified by linear interpolation between the plain 72,000.0 and 66,000.0 gridline labels (the line measures ~68,920-69,040, i.e. the light-green 69,011.1 tag); 69,361.4 is a separate red level immediately above. NOTE: the same green line appears in IMG_7815 and IMG_7812 where colliding tags made it look like 69,361.4 - the IMG_7815 record has been annotated accordingly. Last price is unambiguous: teal label '69,194.1' with countdown '22:19', matching the header quote 69,194.1 −2,109.9 (−2.96%). Timeframe from the TradingView footer ('BTCUSD  1H'); no venue string is legible (the title is truncated as 'Perpetual C...'). The two hand-drawn black horizontal lines and the grey zone box carry NO price tags - the ~72,250, ~67,450 and ~68,050-68,750 figures are interpolated from the gridlines and are approximations, flagged as such rather than presented as read values. The 'Here look closely...' message has no visible author/timestamp header (Discord grouped it under the preceding 27/03 04:40 message seen in IMG_7817), so its timestamp is left null. The greyed line above the 04:44 message is a reply-quote of the 27/03 02:01 message. The 04:44 message is cut off mid-sentence at the bottom of the frame ('When bearish order blocks get rejected it' - continues below). Faint watchlist rows 'PUMPUS...' and 'AVAXUS...' bleed through behind the footer. No reaction counts visible.
